# rename to SOURCES.yaml. What the kit did not write (see ../WRITING-A-KIT.md, section 7).
- what: the CLASSNAME class package, installed form
  version: "v1.0 (2026-01-01)"
  files: [tex]
  except: [tex/upstream]
  from: TeX Live 2026 (texmf-dist/tex/latex)
  authors: who wrote it, from its files
  license: LPPL-1.3c
- what: the complete CTAN distribution of CLASSNAME
  files: [tex/upstream]
  from: https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/CLASSNAME.zip
  authors: who wrote it
  license: LPPL-1.3c
  archive-sha256: the SHA-256 of the zip you downloaded
- what: citation style
  files: [STYLE.csl]
  commit: the commit scripts/fetch-csl.py printed
  license: CC-BY-SA-3.0
